frames.title: Lesson 219 · Probability (be likely to, be unlikely to) — use

body: **Foco:** Probabilidade (be likely to, be unlikely to) — uso.
**Verbos:** reconsider.
**Pronúncia:** Ligações e assimilação.
**20 palavras novas** (desenvolvimento profissional).
**Texto do dia:** editorial / opinião.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (B2):** eu consigo opinar sobre o futuro do escritório com be likely to, be unlikely to, may well e be bound to num editorial, e usar reconsider.

body: Esta aula treina **responder em frases completas (IELTS Speaking, TOEFL Speaking)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.title: Editorial: Time to Reconsider the Office
paras: Many firms are **likely to** keep hybrid schedules, and few are **unlikely to** admit that full-time presence was never essential. Leaders who **reconsider** old habits are **bound to** attract talent; those who do not **may well** lose it.
It is **unlikely that** every job can be done from home, but it is **highly likely that** flexibility will become standard.

items.q: The editorial says hybrid schedules are likely to stay.
It claims every job can be done from home.
Leaders who reconsider are bound to attract talent.

head: Estrutura
Grau
Exemplo
rows: be bound to / be certain to
**It is highly likely that rules will change.**

blocks.body: Com **it is likely that + oração** ou **sujeito + is likely to + verbo**. O sentido é o mesmo; a segunda forma é mais direta.
Cuidado: *probably* fica **antes do verbo principal**: *They will probably stay*.

items.s: Leaders who reconsider are ___ to attract talent. (bound)
It is ___ that flexibility will become standard. (likely)
Few firms are ___ to admit it. (unlikely)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

items.ans: Is the office likely to disappear

body: **Bound to happen.** — Vai acontecer com certeza.
**The writing is on the wall.** — Já se vê o que vem aí.
**A sign of the times.** — Sinal dos tempos.
**Shake things up.** — Mudar o jeito das coisas.
**Back to square one.** — De volta à estaca zero.
**Here to stay.** — Veio para ficar.
**Think outside the box.** — Pensar fora da caixa.
**Is the office likely to disappear?** — O escritório tende a desaparecer?
**Could firms lose talent?** — As empresas podem perder talentos?
**They may well, if they don’t reconsider.** — Podem muito bem, se não reconsiderarem.

blocks.title: Opinion
lines: Is the office likely to disappear?
No, but hybrid work is bound to stay.
Não, mas o trabalho híbrido com certeza vai ficar.
They may well, if they don’t reconsider.
Podem muito bem, se não reconsiderarem.

items.label: Ligações e assimilação
items.note: Sons se ligam e se transformam: did you → didja, want you → wanchu, pick it up → pi-ki-dup.

prompts.model: Remote work is bound to grow.
Firms may well change their rules.

blocks.task: Write an 80-word opinion about the future office using three probability structures.
blocks.model: Hybrid work is bound to stay. Many companies are likely to keep flexible schedules, and few are unlikely to admit that daily presence was never essential. Leaders who reconsider old habits may well attract better talent. It is unlikely that every job can be done from home, but it is highly likely that flexibility will become standard.
checklist: Usei **bound to / likely to / unlikely to / may well**

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
